Robotic Unit for Security and Human-assistance
Known as "R.U.S.H.," it is a unit organized to investigate the Workloid rampage incidents, made up of a human Captain and Workloid "Buddies."

"BR-01G Aile" is designed as an all-purpose unit capable of handling any mission by swapping its equipped C.A.R.D.
It is truly the latest model, equipped with abilities worthy of being called a Buddy.

"BR-03T Flare" is a unit designed for the traffic mobile squad, specializing in high-speed movement powered by its Sprint Booster.
No one has ever escaped her legs.

"BR-02S Grit Heart" is a heavily armored, high-output Buddy known for its massive right arm, specializing in VIP protection and base defense.
With an unbreakable body and spirit, it protects its allies through any difficult mission.

"BR-04F Luminol" possesses not only combat capability to counter rampaging Workloids, but also excellent forensic skills for crime scene analysis and scientific investigation.
Behind her alluring smile, a cool and calculating mind is always at work.

Despite her small and cute appearance, "BR-05A Mini" is a Buddy specializing in assault operations such as riot suppression and hostage rescue.
Anyone who is fooled by her adorable looks and underestimates her will always come to regret it.

Rampaging Workloids obey neither human commands nor their own programming.
However, their behavior follows one consistent pattern:
destruction and chaos.

Each Buddy has its own trump card for countering rampaging Workloids.
By activating RUSH Mode, a Buddy can be pushed into overdrive,
gaining overwhelming speed and power, if only for a moment.

The Workloids known as "Buddies" are designed to prioritize their Captain's orders above all else, no matter what happens.
Perhaps that could be called trust.
This is Sync City, a crystallization of cutting-edge technology, where every aspect of people's lives is supported by the city management AI "SE.RA.PH" and robots known as "Workloids."
One day, the "Workloids" that manage the city suddenly began to run rampant, and incidents of them attacking people became frequent, plunging Sync City into chaos. The cause has yet to be identified.

Taking the "Workloid Rampage Incidents" seriously,
SE.RA.PH and the Sync City Police
organized a special task force to counter the rampaging Workloids.

R.U.S.H., please deploy!"
